craft_notes: Sthāyin: entered powers; solitude. Rows: presence then calm. Read aloud: settled tread.

lines: In these seats and the rest, by the Highest's decree,
powers, by the Highest entered, take on flesh —
as Aryan lands for the righteous,
as outcast lands for the unrighteous;
the mountain-top word, through lonely calm
shunning stray thoughts, is one-pointedness' seat.
l4.sanskrit_cite: teṣu teṣu pīṭhādisthāneṣu parameśaniyatyā parameśvarāviṣṭānāṃ śaktīnāṃ dehagrahaṇāt āryadeśā iva dhārmikāṇāṃ mlecchadeśā iva adhārmikāṇām parvatāgrādeś caikāntatvena vikṣepaparihārāt aikāgryapadatvam iti
